task_summary: 用户要求按 skill 写法修复研发助手规则缺陷，候选规则包含触发、正向动作、完成检查和 gate。

instruction_shape.trigger: When the user reports Engineering Assistant rule defects or asks to revise a skill.
instruction_shape.do: Classify the task as assistant audit/self-healing, keep edits inside assistant skill roots, and explain the target behavior first.
instruction_shape.checks: Record assistant_rule_or_capability_audit, explicit_project_code_change_requested, allowed_edit_roots, and target_repo_edits.
instruction_shape.gate: ASSISTANT_AUDIT_TARGET_REPO_EDIT_FORBIDDEN only when target repo edits occur without explicit project-code request.
